blocks.text: 隆重推出 ZONOS3-Mini：一款紧凑的零样本语音克隆文本转语音（TTS）模型，性能达到业界领先水平，并具备领先的语音控制能力，可在设备端实时运行。

inlines.text: 隆重推出 ZONOS3-Mini：一款紧凑的零样本语音克隆文本转语音（TTS）模型，性能达到业界领先水平，并具备领先的语音控制能力，可在设备端实时运行。

blocks.text: 我们很高兴地宣布推出 ZONOS3-Mini，这是我们新一代的实时文本转语音（TTS）模型，支持高保真语音克隆。ZONOS3-Mini 是一个稀疏混合专家（MoE）模型，激活参数 1 亿、总参数 8 亿，采用 Apache 2.0 许可。我们使用 112 块 Nvidia H100 训练 ZONOS3-Mini，耗时 2.5 天。你可以在 Zyphra Inference 上访问它（由 Nvidia H200 提供算力），也可以在自己的 GPU 上运行，或直接在浏览器中于设备端使用。

上访问它（由 Nvidia H200 提供算力），也可以在自己的 GPU 上运行，或直接在浏览器中于设备端使用。

blocks.text: 在 ZONOS2 上，我们已经证明：通过为 TTS 采用 MoE 架构，可以缓解质量与推理性能之间的取舍。但 ZONOS2 为此付出了 8B 参数的代价，其编解码器运行在 86 Hz，限制了模型的部署。ZONOS3-Mini 通过在技术栈的多个层面实现大幅效率提升，绕开了这些限制。

inlines.text: 在 ZONOS2 上，我们已经证明：通过为 TTS 采用 MoE 架构，可以缓解质量与推理性能之间的取舍。但 ZONOS2 为此付出了 8B 参数的代价，其编解码器运行在 86 Hz，限制了模型的部署。ZONOS3-Mini 通过在技术栈的多个层面实现大幅效率提升，绕开了这些限制。

blocks.text: 得益于其小巧的体量，ZONOS3-Mini 可以运行在众多设备上。我们发布了面向浏览器的 WebGPU 运行时、面向服务器的 SGLang 和 vLLM 运行时，以及通过 GGML 提供的众多其他运行时。ZONOS3-Mini 可实时运行：在 Pixel 9 的浏览器中，首包音频时间（Time To First Audio）低于 570 ms；在 M3 MacBook Air 上低于 150 ms。

blocks.text: 第一项重大改进在表示层面。Descript Audio Codec（DAC）虽然保真度极高，但极难建模，而且帧率高达 86 Hz，限制了实时语音生成。为解决这些问题，我们训练了自己的编解码器 Zyphra Audio Codec 1（ZAC-1）。在相近的数据约束下，用 ZAC-1 训练的模型词错误率比用 DAC 训练的模型降低 10 倍，同时声学相似度更好。与 S1-DAC、MOSS v2 等主流 TTS 编解码器相比，它在更高压缩率下取得相当的结果，或在相近压缩率下取得更好的结果。这得益于它为 TTS 主干模型提供了更利于建模的表示。

blocks.text: 第二，我们整合了 LLM 领域发展出的架构改进。ZONOS3-Mini 的序列混合器采用 Gated DeltaNet（GDN）与全局注意力 3:1 的混合结构，帮助我们在更长上下文长度下实现更强性能和更高吞吐量。我们还集成了潜在 MoE、Q balancing 和 Attention Residuals，在我们这一模型规模下显著提升了性能。

blocks.text: 第三，我们把声音表示从 Qwen3-TTS 说话人编码器换成了 MECT-B2 说话人验证模型。这既提升了下游说话人相似度，也让说话人操控更易处理。ZONOS3-Mini 支持两种说话人条件模式。第一种模式在预训练阶段就用上下文中的单独片段从头训练，输出更自然，代价是不能精确复制韵律。第二种模式使用目标片段的直接声音表示，在预训练后经过一个短阶段微调。

inlines.text: 第三，我们把声音表示从 Qwen3-TTS 说话人编码器换成了 MECT-B2 说话人验证模型。这既提升了下游说话人相似度，也让说话人操控更易处理。ZONOS3-Mini 支持两种说话人条件模式。第一种模式在预训练阶段就用上下文中的单独片段从头训练，输出更自然，代价是不能精确复制韵律。第二种模式使用目标片段的直接声音表示，在预训练后经过一个短阶段微调。

blocks.text: 除了业界领先的可懂度和说话人相似度，ZONOS3-Mini 还能对说话人身份和表达方式进行广泛控制。我们的控制维度覆盖年龄、性别、口音和音质等身份特征，通过说话人嵌入向量实现，并针对口音专门使用任务向量。语速、情感、投射感和生动度等表达控制则通过激活引导（Activation Steering）实现。除了在话语层面进行引导，我们还利用注意力中学习到的对齐头，在词级别上引导表达。此外，我们基于 VoiceCraft 方案发布了一个编辑模型，让用户能够像普通生成一样无缝修改句子，并享有同样的控制能力。

blocks.text: Introducing ZONOS3-Mini, a compact zero-shot voice-cloning Text To Speech (TTS) model with state-of-the-art performance as well as leading voice control capabilities which can run in real-time on-device.

inlines.text: Introducing ZONOS3-Mini, a compact zero-shot voice-cloning Text To Speech (TTS) model with state-of-the-art performance as well as leading voice control capabilities which can run in real-time on-device.

blocks.text: We are excited to announce ZONOS3-Mini, our next-generation real-time text-to-speech (TTS) model with high-fidelity voice cloning. ZONOS3-Mini is a sparse Mixture of Experts (MoE) model with 100 million active parameters and 800 million total parameters licensed under Apache 2.0. We trained ZONOS3-Mini on 112 Nvidia H100s in 2.5 days. You can access it on Zyphra Inference served on Nvidia H200s, on your own GPU, or in your browser on-device.

blocks.text: With ZONOS2, we established that the tradeoff between quality and inference performance can be mitigated by using MoE architectures for TTS. However, ZONOS2 did so at the cost of 8B parameters on a codec running at 86 Hz which limited the deployment of the model. ZONOS3-Mini sidesteps these limitations thanks to large efficiency gains at multiple layers of the stack.

blocks.text: Thanks to its size, ZONOS3-Mini can run on a multitude of devices. We release runtimes for browsers via WebGPU, servers via SGLang and vLLM, as well as many others through GGML. ZONOS3-Mini runs in real-time with <570 ms of Time To First Audio in the browser on a Pixel 9 and <150 ms on an M3 MacBook Air.

blocks.text: “I must not overfit. Overfitting is the model-killer. Overfitting is the little loss that brings total generalization failure. I will face my loss. I will permit the gradient to pass backward over me and through me. And when it has propagated, I will turn the validation eye to see its path. Where the loss has gone there will be convergence. Only the learned representation will remain.”

blocks.text: For ZONOS3-Mini, we made substantial improvements at the level of the codec, the architecture, and the speaker encoder.

inlines.text: For ZONOS3-Mini, we made substantial improvements at the level of the codec, the architecture, and the speaker encoder.

blocks.text: The first major improvement is at the representation level. Descript Audio Codec (DAC) despite its extreme fidelity is incredibly hard to model and limits real-time speech generation due to its high framerate (86 Hz). To improve upon these problems we trained our own codec Zyphra Audio Codec 1 (ZAC-1). Under similar data constraints, a model trained with ZAC-1 achieves a 10x reduction in word error rate compared with one trained with DAC while achieving better acoustic similarity. When compared to leading TTS codecs like S1-DAC and MOSS v2 it achieves comparable results at better compression or better results at similar compression. It achieves this by creating a more favorable representation for the TTS backbone to model.

blocks.text: Second, we integrate architecture improvements that have been developed in LLMs. The sequence mixers in ZONOS3-Mini follow a 3:1 hybrid of Gated DeltaNet (GDN) and global attention which helps us achieve stronger performance as well as higher throughput at longer context lengths. We also integrate latent MoE, Q balancing, and Attention Residuals which significantly improved performance at our model scale.

inlines.text: Second, we integrate architecture improvements that have been developed in LLMs. The sequence mixers in ZONOS3-Mini follow a 3:1 hybrid of Gated DeltaNet (GDN) and global attention which helps us achieve stronger performance as well as higher throughput at longer context lengths. blocks.text: Third, we change our voice representation from the Qwen3-TTS speaker encoder to the MECT-B2 speaker verification model. This both improves downstream speaker similarity and makes speaker manipulation more tractable. ZONOS3-Mini supports two modes of speaker conditioning. The first mode is trained from the start during pretraining with a separate clip in context. This achieves a more natural output at the cost of not copying prosody exactly. The second mode uses a direct voice representation of the target clip and is finetuned in a short stage after pretraining.

blocks.text: Following our previous release of ZTTS1-Eval, we now release the Zyphra TTS Evaluation v2 (ZTTS2-Eval). ZTTS2-Eval expands the clean set of ZTTS1 to cover 35 languages and its in-the-wild set to cover 20 languages, both at a higher sample count per language. Qwen3-ASR is supplemented by Whisper Large v3 in lower-resource languages as well as English where it advantages Qwen TTS models. The TTSDS2 prosody metrics used in ZTTS1-Eval are superseded by new metrics for rhythm and pitch distribution matching as well as an adjusted Masked Prosody Model embedding distance with a scrambled input floor expanding the range spanned by models.

ZTTS2-Eval expands the clean set of ZTTS1 to cover 35 languages and its in-the-wild set to cover 20 languages, both at a higher sample count per language. blocks.text: With the increased number of metrics, especially across languages and conditions, we include a new Zyphra TTS Capability Index v1 based on the Epoch Capability Index using item response theory over 420 items (metric x test set x language), each with its own difficulty and slope. ZONOS3-Mini ranks first among open models followed by Fish S2 Pro and MOSS TTS v1.5.

blocks.text: In addition to state-of-the-art intelligibility and speaker similarity, ZONOS3-Mini features extensive control of speaker identity and delivery. Our control axes span identity across age, gender, accent, and quality through speaker embedding vectors and task vectors for accents specifically. Delivery control including pace, emotion, projection, and liveliness is achieved through Activation Steering. Along with steering at the utterance level, we leverage learned alignment heads in attention to steer delivery at the word level. Furthermore, an edit model is released based on a VoiceCraft recipe, allowing users to modify sentences seamlessly with the same control as normal generations.
